- Return the combined parameters as a URL-encoded string

- The result should be all parameters URL-encoded and sorted

```
def prepare_form_encoded_body(oauth_params, body):
    # Extract existing parameters from the body
    existing_params = extract_params(body) if body else []
    
    # Merge existing parameters with OAuth parameters
    merged_params = list(existing_params)
    merged_params.extend(oauth_params)
    
    # Sort parameters so OAuth parameters come after non-OAuth ones
    merged_params.sort(key=lambda i: i[0].startswith('oauth_'))
    
    # URL encode the merged parameters
    return urlencode(merged_params)
